purpose: Define skill depth by behavior-bearing decision structure rather than prose volume or a mandatory heading template.

dimensions.ownership: The skill owns one non-duplicative decision boundary and names what remains outside it.
dimensions.inputs_inherited_obligations: It declares the information and non-waivable parent/product obligations that constrain the decision.
dimensions.observation_protocol: It says what must actually be inspected, measured, rendered, run, compared or elicited before reasoning.
dimensions.branch_logic_tradeoffs: It contains conditional decision paths and explains what changes the choice rather than emitting one universal rule.
dimensions.counterfactual_falsification: It names tests, removals, contrasts or contradictory evidence capable of disproving its current thesis.
dimensions.evidence: Material claims are bound to traceable product, source, runtime, rendered, research or normative evidence with uncertainty retained.
dimensions.output_semantics: The output carries typed decisions, unresolved conflicts and downstream-relevant consequences rather than prose confidence.
dimensions.failure_topology: The skill distinguishes multiple failure mechanisms with different repairs rather than one generic quality warning.
dimensions.escalation_recovery: It defines when to stop local iteration, reopen research, re-contract, re-route or re-diverge.
dimensions.downstream_verification: It names who/what independently verifies the decision and what evidence can block completion.

anti_template_rule: Shared headings are allowed; identical decision/evidence payloads across unrelated skills are a suspicious signal. Domain-specific mechanisms and failure surfaces must remain bespoke.
passing_rule: All ten dimensions require concrete evidence plus a decision consequence. Length never substitutes for a missing dimension.
reopen_conditions: new failure class bypasses an existing skill
a semantic mutation changes force without detection
a skill cannot name evidence capable of falsifying itself
